name: Inworld Realtime TTS-2
access: Inworld TTS API: unary POST /tts/v1/voice, streaming POST /tts/v1/voice:stream, WebSocket /v1/tts/synthesize:websocket, async and batch jobs (preview), model id inworld-tts-2
Inworld TTS Playground, Inworld CLI and MCP server
Inworld Realtime API (speech to speech), which renders its speech with this model
Integrations: LiveKit, Twilio, Pipecat and others

voice.input_audio: none: the model takes text, with bracketed steering instructions, non-verbal tags, SSML break tags, inline IPA and verbatim tags
voice.output_audio: MP3 (16 to 48 kHz, 32 to 320 kbps; the default), PCM, WAV and LINEAR16 (16-bit, 8 to 48 kHz), Opus (8 to 48 kHz, 32 to 192 kbps), mu-law and A-law (8 kHz) [iw-audio]
voice.voices: built-in voices, instant voice cloning from as little as 3 seconds of audio, professional voice cloning (beta), and voice design from a description of 7 to 1,024 characters [iw-audio] [iw-clone] [iw-design] [iw-intro]
languages: 200+ languages and locales in two tiers; Tier 1 is Arabic, Chinese, Dutch, English, French, German, Hebrew, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish [iw-lang]
voice.latency: 100 ms P90 time to first audio byte, measured server-side and excluding network latency, at high concurrency per the maker; Inworld Realtime TTS-2 Flash is stated at 20 ms [iw-intro]
voice.session_limit: 2,000 characters per unary request, 4,000 per streaming request, 2,000 per WebSocket sendText message, and 100,000 characters per async job (10,000 on On-Demand; async is preview) [iw-unary] [iw-ws]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per character, not per token. Inworld bills per million characters and lowers the rate on higher plans. Realtime TTS-2: On-Demand US$25, Creator US$20 (plan fee US$25 a month), Builder US$17.50 (US$100), Developer US$15 (US$300), Growth US$12.50 (US$1,500) and Enterprise as low as US$5 [iw-pricing] [iw-billing]. The Batch API costs 20% less per character [iw-billing]. On-Demand includes up to 70 minutes of free TTS [iw-billing]. Context text sent in `synthesisContext` is not billed [iw-guide]. Artificial Analysis lists US$20.83 per 1M characters [aa-tts-board]
